rule: D orders touching a gap are indeterminate. s_live and gap-17 snapshots fall back to the REST product book, flagged. Jev skips packets with a missing 1m bar; these count as indeterminate, and the week is flagged if more than 5% are skipped. Stops are stop-first on the REST 15m bar. If a gap covers a stop level, the stop fills at the first available price after the gap, using the existing gap-fill convention, and is logged as a gap fill. The stale-feed and 5%-missing kills stay as registered. Gap caps: at most 1% of time gapped per week; no single gap over 15 min; no-go if the gap rate in top-decile realized-vol hours exceeds 2x the overall rate. The soak lasts at least 7 days, and the same caps run as a weekly forward monitor that flags that week's Jev and D stats.
